name: Tidal Hands
text:
With an emphatic gesture, you create waves that rush out from you in the shape of your hands. You either form two 15-foot cones that don't overlap or you combine the hands into one 30-foot cone. Each creature in a wave takes floor((@actor.level -1/2)+1)d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC. If a creature critically fails, you also push that creature 5 feet.

---

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.
